example.zh: 照这样的情况，很抱歉，我不能接受你的盛情邀请。
example.en: As such is the case, I am sorry I can't accept your kind invitation.

example.zh: 他的性情古怪。
example.en: He's a strange character.

example.zh: 她所说的话是不真实的。
example.en: What she said wasn't true.

example.zh: 我父亲的状况时好时坏。
example.en: My father's condition seems to improve one moment, but the next moment he sinks again.

example.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。
example.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.

example.zh: 他被很多人围着，自然变得有点紧张。
example.en: With so many people around he naturally became a bit nervous.
